description: This PHP source file generates a web interface for configuring the DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) settings on a network device. It includes PHP code to retrieve current configuration values, embedded JavaScript for client-side validation and UI interaction, and HTML markup for user input fields, specifically for enabling/disabling DMZ and setting IPv4 and IPv6 host addresses.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string with possible '::' shorthand and expands it into an array of 8 hextets.

methods.name: IsBlank
methods.description: Checks whether input fields with a specific prefix are all empty, with special handling for IPv6 address parts.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates the values of input fields with a given prefix using a specified separator to form an IP address string.

methods.name: isIp6AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines whether IPv6 address fields are required based on the current form state.

methods.name: isIp4AddrRequired
methods.description: Determines whether IPv4 address fields are required based on the current form state.

methods.name: saveQoS
methods.description: Sends the DMZ configuration data via AJAX to the server to save the settings.

methods.name: populate_IPv6
methods.description: Populates IPv6 address fields with values from the local prefix or disables them if no prefix is set.
